titre: Awzid — Learn Arabic step by step
description: Awzid, an online school of Arabic and the Quran: the classroom method, sources cited. Closed beta, by invitation only: join the waiting list.
h1: Learn Arabic step by step, with the classroom method, sources cited.
intro: Awzid is an online school of Arabic and the Quran for children, teenagers and adults, on their own or as a family. Everyone moves at their own pace, without stress.
beta: Awzid is in closed beta: people join by invitation, in small groups, so that everything is done with care. Leave your address and we will write to you when a place opens up.
consent: I agree that my address is kept to manage the waiting list and to send me my invitation.
ok: Thank you. Your request is saved. When a place opens up, you will receive an invitation by e-mail.

f1_p: A progressive course, lesson after lesson, drawn from our own classroom books: each piece of knowledge builds on the previous one.
f2_p: Every piece of religious content points to its source, and corrections are published openly.
f3_p: A parent account with one profile per child, or a standalone adult account. Everyone moves at their own pace.
f4_p: The app also works without a connection, with no advertising and no tracking of your habits.
dispo_1: Arabic lessons by level, with corrected exercises and lesson audio.
dispo_3: Memorisation tools: a hifẓ notebook and revision.
dispo_4: A family account (parent and child profiles) or an adult account.
dispo_5: Use without a connection, in light or dark mode.
bientot_1: Listening to the Quran with several reciters.
bientot_2: Listening to your recitation to help you correct yourself, never replacing the teacher.
bientot_3: The app in English, Spanish, German and Arabic.
bientot_4: Islamic sciences, text by text, after careful review.
bientot_5: A space for schools and teachers.
rgpd_titre: What we do with your address
rgpd_resp: Data controller: [company name and postal address: to be completed by the client].
rgpd_fin: Purpose: to manage the waiting list and send you an invitation. We keep your address and the language of this page, nothing else: no newsletter, no advertising, no tracking.
rgpd_base: Legal basis: your consent (the box above).
rgpd_duree: Retention: 12 months at most, then automatic deletion, or earlier on request.
rgpd_dest: Recipients: the Awzid team only. Data is hosted in the European Union, in Paris.
rgpd_droits: Your rights: to access your address, have it corrected or erased, unsubscribe and withdraw your consent at any time by writing to contact@awzid.com (reply within 30 days). You may also complain to the data protection authority of your country (in France, the CNIL).
pied_note: Awzid — Growing in knowledge. Closed beta: the legal texts are provisional.
